$comment: Provenance for the tree-sitter grammar .wasm blobs smelt bundles and therefore
redistributes. This file exists because the facts in it have no machine-readable
source on this machine: a .wasm blob carries no metadata, and the grammar packages
are tree-sitter-wasms' own devDependencies, so they are never installed here.
It holds ONLY the irreducible facts. Everything else in THIRD-PARTY.md is derived:
the version ranges come from tree-sitter-wasms' package.json, the file list comes
from WASM_BY_LANGUAGE, and the sizes and hashes come from the bundled files.
